thread:
Elaine Park: Posting the draft of the product launch blog for review — aiming to go live next week. Need Brand + Legal + Product eyes by EOD Thursday so ops can schedule. Paste below and then a short checklist after.

Matt R: reading now. quick ask — hero stat needs a source link. also prefer shorter second paragraph.

Sophie L: skimmed. tiny wording nit: change 'optimizing cost per token' -> 'reducing inference cost' for clarity.

Jordan - Product: can we add a single sentence about Dedicated capacity (predictable throughput + reserved GPUs)? keeps evals consistent.

Alek C: social/calendar note — webinar CTA should be scheduled 48 hours before publish. we'll need the landing URL + short copy.

Maya (Brand): overall looks good. please swap hero image to the V1 renders in /assets/launch/v1. also prefer the term 'inference platform' over 'inference runtime' across the doc.

legal-bot: Automated scan complete — flag: potential competitor mention 'XCloud' in paragraph 3. Please either remove or add citation and business exception.

Elaine Park: Good catch. Replaced the reference with 'other managed inference providers' (updated draft below). Also updated Product blurb. New excerpt pasted:

```markdown
Redwood Optimize reduces unit inference cost while preserving output quality. Teams can pin model versions, configure caching and batching, and route requests by latency or cost policy — all with per-route observability.

For customers needing predictable throughput, Redwood Dedicated offers reserved GPU pools and SLA-backed targets for latency and uptime.
```

Sophie L: looks much better. one tiny comma change on line 2. LGTM :thumbsup:

Matt R: approve pending hero-stat source. sending to analytics for verification.

Kayla (Analytics): Verified hero stat — internal Q4 benchmarks show median per-token cost reduction of 32% vs baseline. Source: internal report. Link: https://redwood.internal/reports/benchmark-q4-2025 (permissioned)

Nora (Legal): read the redacted draft. Approved — no further redactions required.

Maya (Brand): Approved from Brand POV. Confirm final hero image ID: launch-hero-v1-3.

marketing-ops: please confirm scheduling window. We need CMS draft, hero image, UTM list, webinar url, and social copy.

Elaine Park: Final checklist attached below — please thumbs up when you have your piece ready.
- CMS draft: https://cms.redwood/internal/launch-blog-draft-2026-04
- Hero image ID: launch-hero-v1-3 (located in /assets/launch/v1)
- UTM template: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=optimize_launch
- Webinar landing: https://events.redwood.com/intro-optimize (placeholder, Alek to confirm)
- Short social blurbs: queued, see /marketing/social/optimize_launch

Alek C: I'll confirm webinar landing and queue social. Proposed event title: "Intro to Redwood Optimize — cost-efficient inference in production". CTA short: "Sign up: https://events.redwood.com/intro-optimize"

Jordan - Product: added a one-line product note for Dedicated into the CMS draft. Also added a 2-line quote from PM about rollout plans.

Matt R: thanks everyone. quick reminder: add UTM tags to all social links, and add tracking pixel for webinar signups.

Elaine Park: All approvals in. Locking copy and sending to marketing-ops to schedule. Target publish: 2026-04-02 09:00 PT. Webinar email blast: 2026-03-31 09:00 PT; social cadence: day 0, day +1, day +3.

marketing-ops: Received — scheduling now. Will post final queue and screenshots when done.

Maya (Brand): final note — please use the brand-approved CTAs from the shared doc. Small differences in capitalization matter.

Elaine Park: Noted. Thanks everyone — closing the thread. :party_parrot:
